name: Your Guardian Angel
overview: Scripture reveals that God sends His angels as divine guardians to protect, guide, and minister to His people. In Exodus 23:20, God promises to send an angel to lead and bring believers into the place He has prepared. The Psalms affirm that angels encamp around those who fear the Lord, delivering and keeping them in all their ways (Psalms 34:7; 91:11). Daniel 6:22 illustrates an angel's power to intervene for the innocent, while Zechariah 1:10 describes angels as active servants walking the earth under God's command. Even in the New Testament, angels minister to Christ Himself after His victory over temptation (Matthew 4:11), underscoring their role as faithful servants of God’s will.
